messages:
jess: quick: for auto-switchover UX — expose p95 + error% fields or one simple safety slider?
ryan: p95 + error% separate. operators need the signals.
priya: agree. add preset dropdown (conservative / balanced / aggressive) to simplify for product teams. advanced collapsed.
ajess: defaults for hosted guess: p95=400ms, error_rate=1%. per-route presets for embeddings vs chat.
ryan: must show which error classes count (5xx, model-timeout, model-reject). UI should list them inline.
priya: preview idea: estimated switch % computed from sampled telemetry (24-72h, default sample_pct=5%). show matched/total.
ops-bot: warning: full scans costly. recommend sampling + capped windows.
ajess: audit defaults: canary=10% capture, auto-fallback=1%. show cost badge and a "capture payload" toggle (off by default).
ryan: oscillation protection: min_switch_interval + debounce + exponential backoff. expose controls but keep sane defaults.
priya: operator overrides require reason + optional TTL and create audit events. show undo for 5m.
ajess: i'll mock UI: two inputs + presets, advanced rule builder, preview sim, hysteresis controls, audit toggles, override timeline. posting tomorrow.
